pr_title: Add smb synced folders to fstab
pr_comments:
Need to revisit this. Found a bug around fstab entries being overwritten when using multiple types of synced folders. For example, for the Vagrantfile
```
Vagrant.configure("2") do |config|
  config.vm.box = "hashicorp/bionic64"
  config.vm.synced_folder ".", "/vagrant", type: "smb"
  config.vm.synced_folder "../other", "/other"
end
```

the expected fstab entry by Vagrant is something like
```
#VAGRANT-BEGIN
# The contents below are automatically generated by Vagrant. Do not modify.
other /other vboxsf uid=1000,gid=1000,nofail 0 0
<smb mount location> /vagrant cifs <smb mount options> 0 0
#VAGRANT-END
```

the actual fstab entry is
```
#VAGRANT-BEGIN
# The contents below are automatically generated by Vagrant. Do not modify.
other /other vboxsf uid=1000,gid=1000,nofail 0 0
#VAGRANT-END
```

I'm going to lock this issue because it has been closed for _30 days_ ⏳. This helps our maintainers find and focus on the active issues.

If you have found a problem that seems similar to this, please open a new issue and complete the issue template so we can capture all the details necessary to investigate further.

issue_context.title: Rebooting Ubuntu guest after provisioning kills /vagrant mount point
issue_context.body:
If I reboot my Ubuntu guest after provisioning, the `/vagrant` mount point is empty. If I comment out the line rebooting the guest, the folder contains the contents of the current folder on the host as expected.

### Vagrant version

```
C:\> vagrant -v
Vagrant 2.2.8
```

### Host operating system

* Windows 10 Pro Version 1903 (Build 18362.778)
* Hyper-V provider

### Guest operating system

Ubuntu 18.04 LTS (`hashicorp/bionic64`)

### Vagrantfile

```ruby
Vagrant.configure("2") do |config|
  config.vm.box = "hashicorp/bionic64"
  config.vm.provision :shell do |s|
    s.privileged = false
    s.reboot = true
    s.inline = <<-SHELL
      echo "Moo"
    SHELL
  end
end
```

### Debug output

* [vagrant-reboot.log](https://gist.github.com/kthy/22c64b58cc6a3b3e4620036c6e585491)
* [vagrant-noreboot.log](https://gist.github.com/kthy/4b14cbab247860f801fc886d49c23e27) (`s.reboot` line in `Vagrantfile` commented out)

### Expected behavior

I should see the contents of the host directory in `/vagrant`:

```bash
vagrant@ubuntu-18:~$ ls /vagrant/
Vagrantfile
vagrant@ubuntu-18:~$
```

### Actual behavior

```bash
vagrant@ubuntu-18:~$ ls /vagrant/
vagrant@ubuntu-18:~$
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. `vagrant up`
1. `vagrant ssh`
1. `ls /vagrant/`
1. `exit`
1. `vagrant destroy`
1. Comment out `s.reboot = true` and repeat

review_comments:
I think I'm not a huge fan of extending from a module in `Vagrant::Action` here.
I think what I really want here is to have the bit of `Vagrant::Action::Builtin::MixinSyncedFolders.synced_folders` be defined here so that you can do a `machine.synced_folders`?
maybe `mount_type` can be a synced_folder cap?

would be neat if this was defined by the plugin. Something like a constant `SYNCED_FOLDER_TYPE` and then this could be a `initialize_capabilities!(self::SYNCED_FOLDER_TYPE, plugins, capabilities, machine)`
